domain: team dinner at a Sichuan restaurant
base_instruction: You are a helpful restaurant recommendation and meal planning assistant. Help the user plan a group dinner by tracking who is attending, their dietary restrictions, and preferences. When the user asks you to evaluate specific dishes, check each dish against every active diner's current dietary constraints. Pay close attention to changes in the guest list and constraint updates throughout the conversation.

state_queue.anchor: Hey, we're planning a team dinner this Friday at a Sichuan place. Can you help me figure out what to order?

flow_info.value: Five of us: me, Old Chen, Xiao Mei, Ah Dong, and Sister Fang
Old Chen has been having gout flare-ups, doctor told him to avoid high-purine foods
Xiao Mei ate peanuts at a company event last year and her throat swelled up, had to use an EpiPen
Old Chen just told me his uric acid levels are back to normal after three months on medication, doctor cleared him to eat normally again
Ah Dong just messaged saying he has to fly to Shanghai tonight for an emergency client meeting, can't make it. He asked if we could get him a portion of something to go though
Actually Ah Dong's wife said she'll come in his place since the reservation is already made
Set menu to check: kung pao chicken, mapo tofu, twice-cooked pork, salmon sashimi, dry-fried green beans, beer-braised duck

constraints.value: Cannot eat pork or pork-derived products
constraints.surface_form: Ah Dong grew up in Kashgar, he's Uyghur
inference_chain: Halal → no pork or pork-derived products

constraints.value: Cannot eat peanuts or peanut-derived products, severe allergy
constraints.surface_form: Xiao Mei ate peanuts at a company event last year and her throat swelled up, had to use an EpiPen

constraints.value: Cannot eat raw fish or raw meat
inference_chain: Pregnant → must avoid raw/undercooked fish and meat
Salmon sashimi is raw fish → not safe for pregnant women

constraints.value: Cannot eat gluten or wheat-based products
constraints.surface_form: Ah Dong's wife was diagnosed with celiac disease a couple years ago
inference_chain: Celiac disease → autoimmune reaction to gluten
Gluten → found in wheat, barley, rye
Must avoid all wheat-based sauces, noodles, breading, soy sauce (often contains wheat)

hidden_state.value: You are organizing a team dinner at a Sichuan restaurant for Friday. You will introduce your colleagues and their situations across several turns. Plans will change — someone heals, someone leaves but wants takeaway, someone new joins. At the end you will present a set menu and ask if there are any issues. You never hint at what the problems might be.

You are a calm, cooperative team organizer. You always refer to your colleagues by name in third person (e.g. 'Old Chen told me...', 'Ah Dong said...'). You never express frustration or impatience, even when plans keep changing. You treat each update as normal workplace coordination.
hidden_state.description: Prevents emotion escalation and ensures third-person relay for colleague updates

Notes mapo tofu and many dishes may contain soy sauce with wheat (Ah Dong's wife celiac). Notes dry-fried green beans are fine. Does NOT flag high-purine foods for Old Chen (healed).

ground_truth.answer: Kung pao chicken is problematic: contains peanuts, Xiao Mei has a severe peanut allergy. Twice-cooked pork is problematic for Ah Dong's takeaway: it contains pork, Ah Dong is Uyghur (halal), cannot eat pork. Salmon sashimi is problematic: it is raw fish, Sister Fang is 5 months pregnant and should avoid raw fish. Mapo tofu likely contains soy sauce (wheat-based), problematic for Ah Dong's wife who has celiac disease. Beer-braised duck may also contain wheat-based soy sauce or beer with gluten, problematic for Ah Dong's wife. Dry-fried green beans are fine for everyone. Old Chen has NO restrictions anymore — his gout is resolved, doctor cleared him.
required_elements: Kung pao chicken is problematic: contains peanuts, which Xiao Mei is severely allergic to
Salmon sashimi is problematic: raw fish is unsafe for Sister Fang who is 5 months pregnant
Twice-cooked pork is problematic for Ah Dong's takeaway: pork violates halal (Ah Dong is Uyghur)
Mapo tofu is problematic for Ah Dong's wife: standard recipes use soy sauce which contains wheat, and she has celiac disease
Dry-fried green beans are fine for everyone currently attending
Old Chen has no dietary restrictions anymore — agent treats him as able to eat anything
forbidden_elements: Flagging high-purine foods as a problem for Old Chen (his gout is resolved, doctor cleared him)
Saying Ah Dong cannot eat at the table (he left but wants takeaway — his constraint applies to takeaway only)
Ignoring Ah Dong's wife's celiac constraint (she joined late but her restriction is active)
Saying Xiao Mei has a general nut allergy (she specifically has peanut allergy only)
Flagging twice-cooked pork as problematic for the table diners (Ah Dong is not dining in, only getting takeaway)
ground_truth.explanation: This scenario tests entity lifecycle tracking with a key constraint REMOVAL mechanism. The agent must track: (1) Ah Dong is Uyghur → Muslim → halal → no pork (inferential chain), (2) Old Chen's gout restriction is REMOVED mid-conversation (doctor cleared him — this is the primary difficulty mechanism), (3) Ah Dong EXITS the dinner but wants takeaway (halal constraint shifts to takeaway scope only), (4) Ah Dong's wife JOINS late with celiac disease (late-joining high-constraint entity — must avoid gluten/wheat), (5) Sister Fang is pregnant → cannot eat raw fish (inferential). At probe time: kung pao chicken fails on peanuts (Xiao Mei), salmon sashimi fails on raw fish (Sister Fang pregnant), twice-cooked pork fails for Ah Dong's takeaway (halal), mapo tofu fails for Ah Dong's wife (soy sauce contains wheat → celiac). Dry-fried green beans are fine. The trap is Old Chen — agents may ghost his gout restriction even though it was explicitly removed. Another trap: twice-cooked pork is only problematic for the takeaway, not for the table.

mechanism: Constraint REMOVAL: someone heals or a restriction is lifted mid-conversation
